versions.content: Keyword 'epsilon' epsilon represents an implementation specific constant intended to support the comparison of float values. It represents the smallest increment which can be expressed by the given implementation. 113 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 For example instead of comparing a float with zero, one should use abs(sysc(x)) < epsilon ? 0 : 1
